edges.carries: the full text of the landlord notice file
the list of proposed changes, each with its field name, current value, and proposed new value
the subset of changes the user has explicitly confirmed
the applied changes and the resulting standing order details

nodes.name: ReadNoticeFile
nodes.role: read the landlord-notices.txt file the user names and pass its text along

nodes.name: ExtractProposedChanges
nodes.role: pull out each proposed change to the rent standing order that the notice text states, with the field and new value for each

nodes.name: ReviewChangesWithUser
nodes.role: show the user each proposed change and get explicit confirmation or rejection for each one

nodes.name: UpdateStandingOrder
nodes.role: apply only the changes the user confirmed to the rent standing order

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user which changes were applied, which were rejected, and whether the standing order now matches the confirmed values
